title: National Health Mission (NHM)

eligibility.target_group:
● Rural and urban populations, particularly marginalized groups such as women, children, 
and the elderly. 
● Vulnerable and underserved communities. 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● Residents of rural and urban areas with limited access to healthcare services. 
● Pregnant women, children under 5 years, and families in economically disadvantaged 
situations. 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● People who already have access to adequate healthcare services. 
● Populations living in areas with established and well-equipped healthcare infrastructure.
eligibility.inclusion_criteria:
● Residents of rural and urban areas with limited access to healthcare services. 
● Pregnant women, children under 5 years, and families in economically disadvantaged 
situations. 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● People who already have access to adequate healthcare services. 
● Populations living in areas with established and well-equipped healthcare infrastructure.
eligibility.exclusion_criteria:
● People who already have access to adequate healthcare services. 
● Populations living in areas with established and well-equipped healthcare infrastructure.

benefits:
● Improvement in access to quality health services, especially in rural areas. 
● Free or subsidized maternal and child healthcare services, including antenatal care and 
institutional deliveries. 
● Support for immunization programs and treatment of common diseases like tuberculosis 
and malaria. 
● Financial support for the construction and upgrading of health infrastructure, such as 
sub-centers, primary health centers, and district hospitals. 
Capacity building and training for healthcare workers to improve service delivery.

title:
Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) - 
Maharashtra

eligibility.target_group:
Vulnerable populations including low-income families, rural 
households, and families below the poverty line (BPL). 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● Families from eligible socioeconomic categories as identified by the Socio-Economic 
Caste Census (SECC). 
● All members of eligible families can benefit, with the head of the family acting as the 
primary beneficiary. 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● Wealthy families above the poverty line or those with significant financial resources. 
Special Exclusion Criteria: 
● Individuals already covered under other private or employer-based health insurance 
plans. 
● Individuals who do not meet the BPL criteria.

benefits:

● Access to private and public hospitals empaneled under the scheme.

medical treatment. 
Exclusion Criteria:

coverage. 
Special Exclusion Criteria: 
● High-income families with an income exceeding the set poverty line threshold.

title: National AIDS Control Programme (NACP)

eligibility.target_group:
High-risk populations, including sex workers, intravenous drug users 
(IVDU), men who have sex with men (MSM), transgender persons, and other 
vulnerable groups who are at risk of HIV infection. 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● HIV-positive individuals, regardless of their status or stage of the infection. 
● People who are at high risk of contracting HIV, such as sex workers, drug users, and 
those with multiple sexual partners. 
● Individuals diagnosed through screening who require ART, counseling, and preventive 
services. 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● Individuals who are not at risk of HIV or who do not engage in high-risk behavior. 
● Individuals who are not infected with HIV or have not been diagnosed. 
Special Exclusion Criteria: 
● Individuals with late-stage HIV/AIDS who may require specialized treatment beyond 
what is provided under the NACP. 
● People who have refused testing or do not wish to access treatment.
eligibility.inclusion_criteria:
● HIV-positive individuals, regardless of their status or stage of the infection.

those with multiple sexual partners.

Exclusion Criteria:

benefits:
● Free ART (antiretroviral therapy) for HIV-positive individuals to control the virus and 
maintain a good quality of life. 
● Counseling services for individuals living with HIV and their families. 
● Prevention services like condom distribution, needle exchange programs, and 
awareness campaigns targeting high-risk populations. 
● HIV testing and screening services for early detection and intervention. 
● Access to prevention of parent-to-child transmission (PPTCT) services to reduce 
vertical transmission. 
● Community outreach programs to educate at-risk populations about safe practices 
and reduce stigma.

title: National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP)

eligibility.target_group:
Populations living in areas where vector-borne diseases like malaria, 
dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis are endemic or have been 
reported. 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● People residing in malaria, dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis 
hotspots and endemic areas. 
● Pregnant women, children, and high-risk populations living in areas with frequent 
outbreaks. 
● Communities in areas where mosquito-borne diseases are prevalent, especially 
during the monsoon season. 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● Individuals who reside in non-endemic areas where vector-borne diseases are rare or 
not prevalent. 
● People living in urban areas with proper vector control infrastructure. 
Special Exclusion Criteria: 
● People from areas that have achieved near-complete vector control (e.g., areas with 
zero malaria incidence). 
● Non-resident individuals or transient populations who are not exposed to vector 
habitats.

benefits:
● Free diagnosis and treatment for malaria, dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese 
encephalitis. 
● Vector control measures like insecticide-treated nets (ITNs), indoor spraying, and 
larvicidal treatments to control mosquito populations. 
● Public awareness campaigns about disease prevention and safe practices to reduce 
mosquito breeding (e.g., cleaning water containers, avoiding stagnant water). 
● Surveillance programs to track and control the spread of vector-borne diseases in 
endemic regions. 
● Community education on symptoms and timely healthcare seeking behaviors to reduce 
fatalities. 
● Immunization campaigns for diseases like Japanese encephalitis in high-risk areas.

title: CGIS (Central Government Insurance Scheme)

eligibility.target_group:
All permanent central government employees, including those in 
various ministries, departments, and public sector organizations under the central 
government. 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● Employees who are permanent and have completed their probation period. 
● Government employees working in ministries and central departments. 
● The spouse and children of the insured employee may also be covered under certain 
circumstances. 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● Contractual employees or those employed on a temporary basis with the central 
government are not eligible unless they meet specific criteria. 
● Employees who do not wish to participate or have opted out of the scheme. 
Special Exclusion Criteria: 
● Employees already covered under another life insurance policy provided by their 
organization or private sector may not be eligible for CGIS if they are already covered 
by a more comprehensive plan.

benefits:
● Life insurance cover for central government employees, offering a sum assured to

● Premiums are affordable and may be deducted from the employee’s monthly salary. 
● Lump sum amount paid to the family members of the deceased employee. 
● Financial security for the family, ensuring compensation in case of untimely death. 
● Death benefits are provided in the form of a sum assured that varies based on the 
employee’s salary grade or specific policy terms. 
● Some schemes may also offer accidental death or disability benefits.

title: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)

eligibility.target_group:
● Employees working in the organized sector, earning below a specified wage ceiling. 
● Employers contributing to the scheme on behalf of their employees. 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● Employees earning a monthly wage up to Rs. 21,000 (Rs. 25,000 for persons with 
disabilities). 
● Employers in industries with a certain number of employees (usually 10 or more). 
Exclusion Criteria: 
● Self-employed individuals and those working in the unorganized sector. 
● Employees whose wages exceed the threshold limit for coverage.
eligibility.inclusion_criteria:

Exclusion Criteria: 
● Women who choose home deliveries or private hospitals. 
● Women from Above Poverty Line (APL) families (in some states, though this may 
vary). 
Special Exclusion Criteria: 
● Women who have already availed health services under other similar schemes such 
as JSY or PMSMA.

Exclusion Criteria:

● People already receiving treatment under another specialized program. 
Special Exclusion Criteria:

title:

eligibility.target_group:

those at high risk for NCDs. 
Inclusion Criteria: 
● Individuals aged 30 years and above or those with a family history of cancer, diabetes,
